items.title: Territorial Acknowledgement
notes: Mayor McCabe opened the meeting with the following Territorial Acknowledgement:

We would like to begin by acknowledging that the land on which many of us are gathered today is the land traditionally cared for by the Haudenosaunee, Anishnaabe and Neutral peoples. We also acknowledge the enduring presence and deep traditional knowledge and philosophies of the Indigenous people with whom we share this land today.

items.title: Moment of Reflection
notes: Mayor McCabe provided Council with a moment of reflection.
At the beginning of this Council meeting, we pause to think about the needs of our community. May we show wisdom and compassion in all our decisions.

notes: Tova Davidson, Executive Director, Sustainable Waterloo Region gave a presentation with an update to the community on the work that Sustainable Waterloo Region has done in the past year.

items.title: Zoning By-law Amendment Z-24-06,
notes: Tristin Deveau gave a presentation on the proposed application outlining the amendments to the Zoning By-law and the site context. He then responded to questions of Council.
Trevor Hawkins, Partner, MHBC Planning gave a presentation further detailing the proposal. He then responded to questions of Council.
As no one else was present to speak to the application, the Chair concluded the Formal Public Meeting and advised the application is now open to Council for a motion and debate.

items.title: Questions
notes: Councillor Roe had a question for staff about the increase of “renovictions” and “demovictions”, and whether the City has the right tools to protect tenants and the existing affordable rental housing stock. She was wondering if staff are considering renovictions in the rental housing by-law review.

Mark Dykstra confirmed that staff are currently working on it, including doing some research and looking across jurisdictions at other municipalities. They’re working with planning and seeing what can be strengthened in the by-laws around these topics, and there’s more to come in the coming months.

items.title: New Business
notes: Councillor Roe visited Adventure4Change last week and had some great conversations with the team about the work they do for women, youth, and families. They have an event coming up Thursday night, May 2, at the WMRC, which will include a fashion show and a short video.
Mayor McCabe mentioned that the State of the City and Council for a Day are coming up on May 2.
